title: Delta Econ Playbook: adaptive prefetch heuristics and quantization safeguards
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a prescriptive, experiment-driven playbook (Delta Econ Playbook) that captures safe-to-run prefetch heuristics, adaptive KV-cache policies, and quantization guardrails. Goal: reduce hosted per-token compute spend for conversational workloads by 12% while keeping chat-quality regressions under 1.5% on our eval sets. Deliverables: playbook doc, pilot routing policy, a Canary rollout plan, and a tuning checklist for Dedicated customers.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook document published to Confluence with runnable recipes for three workload archetypes: short-chat, multimodal prompts, and long context LLMs
Canary service policy reduces compute cost by >=8% and production quality delta <1.5% in first 2-week pilot
Automated metrics dashboard for token-cost, latency P95, and quality regressions created in Console
Runbook for rollback and customer communication drafted and reviewed
tasks: Design adaptive prefetch heuristics and thresholds (eng + pm) - assigned
Implement safe quantization profiles and runtime checks (eng) - assigned
KV-cache TTL and eviction policy experiments - assigned
Build Canary routing policy and A/B test harness in Console - assigned
Create Confluence playbook with step-by-step tuning recipes - pm owner
Add dashboard panels and alerting for quality/regression signals - ops
decisions: Use heuristic + ML hybrid prefetch: simple rules for 80% cases, small lightweight model recommended for tail cases (Dec 2025 PM/ENG sync)
Quantization: only enable 4-bit variants behind runtime safety checks and per-route fallbacks (Decision 2026-01-20)
Pilot will run on low-risk customer routes and internal Canary traffic before wider rollout
